digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, file-impact scope and attestation
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: indistinguishable between undeclared edits and genuinely-no-file-impact tickets, causing conservative whole-HEAD fallback for both cases
Undeclared file_impact poisons container inheritance: a single child with empty file_impact collapses parent and sibling drift scope to whole-HEAD validation
A tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with explicit no_file_impact_reason declaration must distinguish explicit no-file-impact claims from undeclared omissions
Explicit none declaration must not invalidate attestation on unrelated commits, must not poison container inheritance, and must pass P9 checks
The no-file-impact declaration must be part of the material fingerprint so state transitions invalidate attestation, and a plan-review criterion must judge the truthfulness of the claim
